title: Amazon S3

fields.name: alias
fields.description: Sets an alias, use for multiple instances of the same output plugin.

fields.name: authorization_endpoint_bearer_token
fields.description: Authorization endpoint bearer token.

fields.name: authorization_endpoint_password
fields.description: Authorization endpoint basic authentication password.

fields.name: authorization_endpoint_url
fields.description: Authorization endpoint URL.

fields.name: authorization_endpoint_username
fields.description: Authorization endpoint basic authentication username.

fields.name: auto_retry_requests
fields.description: Immediately retry failed requests to AWS services once. This option doesn't affect the normal Fluent Bit retry mechanism with backoff. Instead, it enables an immediate retry with no delay for networking errors, which can help improve throughput during transient network issues.

fields.name: blob_database_file
fields.description: Absolute path to a database file to be used to store blob files contexts.

fields.name: bucket
fields.description: S3 bucket name.

fields.name: canned_acl
fields.description: Predefined Canned ACL policy for S3 objects.

fields.name: compression
fields.description: Compression type for S3 objects. Supported values: gzip (always available), arrow, parquet (both require Arrow build), and zstd. For gzip and zstd, the Content-Encoding header is set accordingly. arrow and parquet are available only when Fluent Bit is built with -DFLB_ARROW=On and Arrow GLib/Parquet GLib are installed. parquet is typically used with use_put_object On.

fields.name: content_type
fields.description: A standard MIME type for the S3 object, set as the Content-Type HTTP header.

fields.name: endpoint
fields.description: Custom endpoint for the S3 API. Endpoints can contain scheme and port.

fields.name: external_id
fields.description: Specify an external ID for the STS API. Can be used with the role_arn parameter if your role requires an external ID.

fields.name: file_delivery_attempt_limit
fields.description: File delivery attempt limit.

fields.name: host
fields.description: IP address or hostname of the target HTTP server.

fields.name: json_date_format
fields.description: Specify the format of the date. Accepted values: double, epoch, epoch_ms, iso8601 (2018-05-30T09:39:52.000681Z), _java_sql_timestamp_ (2018-05-30 09:39:52.000681).

fields.name: json_date_key
fields.description: Specify the name of the date key in the output record. To disable the time key, set the value to false.

fields.name: log_key
fields.description: By default, the whole log record is sent to S3. When specifying a key name with this option, only the value of that key is sent to S3. For example, when using Docker you can specify log_key log and only the log message is sent to S3.

fields.name: log_level
fields.description: Specifies the log level for output plugin. If not set here, plugin uses global log level in service section.

fields.name: log_suppress_interval
fields.description: Suppresses log messages from output plugin that appear similar within a specified time interval. 0 means no suppression.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Set a tag pattern to match records that output should process. Exact matches or wildcards (for example *).

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Set a regular expression to match tags for output routing. This allows more flexible matching compared to wildcards.

fields.name: net.connect_timeout
fields.description: Set maximum time allowed to establish a connection, this time includes the TLS handshake.

fields.name: net.connect_timeout_log_error
fields.description: On connection timeout, specify if it should log an error. When disabled, the timeout is logged as a debug message.

fields.name: net.dns.mode
fields.description: Select the primary DNS connection type (TCP or UDP).

fields.name: net.dns.prefer_ipv4
fields.description: Select the primary DNS resolver type (LEGACY or ASYNC).

fields.name: net.dns.prefer_ipv6
fields.description: Prioritize IPv6 DNS results when trying to establish a connection.

fields.name: net.io_timeout
fields.description: Set maximum time a connection can stay idle while assigned.

fields.name: net.keepalive_max_recycle
fields.description: Set maximum number of times a keepalive connection can be used before it retries.

fields.name: net.max_worker_connections
fields.description: Set the maximum number of active TCP connections that can be used per worker thread.

fields.name: net.proxy_env_ignore
fields.description: Ignore the environment variables HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY when set.

fields.name: net.source_address
fields.description: Specify network address to bind for data traffic.

fields.name: net.tcp_keepalive
fields.description: Enable or disable Keepalive support.

fields.name: net.tcp_keepalive_interval
fields.description: Interval between TCP keepalive probes when no response is received on a keepidle probe.

fields.name: net.tcp_keepalive_probes
fields.description: Number of unacknowledged probes to consider a connection dead.

fields.name: net.tcp_keepalive_time
fields.description: Interval between the last data packet sent and the first TCP keepalive probe.

fields.name: part_delivery_attempt_limit
fields.description: File part delivery attempt limit.

fields.name: part_size
fields.description: Size of each part when uploading blob files.

fields.name: port
fields.description: TCP port of the target HTTP server.

fields.name: preserve_data_ordering
fields.description: When an upload request fails, the last received chunk might swap with a later chunk, resulting in data shuffling. This feature prevents shuffling by using a queue logic for uploads.

fields.name: profile
fields.description: Option to specify an AWS Profile for credentials.

fields.name: region
fields.description: The AWS region of your S3 bucket. China regions (cn-north-1, cn-northwest-1) and the AWS European Sovereign Cloud region (eusc-de-east-1) are supported; Fluent Bit automatically uses the correct endpoint suffix (.amazonaws.com.cn or .amazonaws.eu) and no custom endpoint is required.

fields.name: retry_limit
fields.description: Set retry limit for output plugin when delivery fails. Integer, no_limits, false, or off to disable, or no_retries to disable retries entirely.

fields.name: role_arn
fields.description: ARN of an IAM role to assume (for example, for cross account access).

fields.name: s3_key_format
fields.description: Format string for keys in S3. This option supports a UUID, strftime time formatters, a syntax for selecting parts of the Fluent log tag using a syntax inspired by the rewrite_tag filter. Add $UUID in the format string to insert a random string. Add $INDEX in the format string to insert an integer that increments each upload. The $INDEX value saves in the store_dir. Add $TAG in the format string to insert the full log tag. Add $TAG[0] to insert the first part of the tag in the S3 key. The tag is split into parts using the characters specified with the s3_key_format_tag_delimiters option. Add the extension directly after the last piece of the format string to insert a key suffix. To specify a key suffix in use_put_object mode, you must specify $UUID. See S3 Key Format. Time in s3_key is the timestamp of the first record in the S3 file.

fields.name: s3_key_format_tag_delimiters
fields.description: A series of characters which will be used to split the tag into parts for use with the s3_key_format option.

fields.name: send_content_md5
fields.description: Send the Content-MD5 header with PutObject and UploadPart requests, as is required when Object Lock is enabled.

fields.name: static_file_path
fields.description: Disables behavior where UUID string appends to the end of the S3 key name when $UUID isn't provided in s3_key_format. $UUID, time formatters, $TAG, and other dynamic key formatters all work as expected while this feature is set to true.

fields.name: store_dir
fields.description: Directory to locally buffer data before sending. Plugin uses the S3 Multipart upload API to send data in chunks of 5 MB at a time.

fields.name: store_dir_limit_size
fields.description: S3 plugin has its own buffering system with files in the store_dir. Use the store_dir_limit_size to limit the amount of data S3 buffers in the store_dir to limit disk usage. If the limit is reached, data will be discarded. Default is 0 which means unlimited.

fields.name: storage_class
fields.description: Specify the storage class for S3 objects. If this option isn't specified, objects store with the default STANDARD storage class.

fields.name: sts_endpoint
fields.description: Custom endpoint for the STS API.

fields.name: tls
fields.description: Enable or disable TLS/SSL support.

fields.name: tls.ca_file
fields.description: Absolute path to CA certificate file.

fields.name: tls.ca_path
fields.description: Absolute path to scan for certificate files.

fields.name: tls.ciphers
fields.description: Specify TLS ciphers up to TLSv1.2.

fields.name: tls.crt_file
fields.description: Absolute path to Certificate file.

fields.name: tls.debug
fields.description: Set TLS debug level. Accepts 0 (No debug), 1 (Error), 2 (State change), 3 (Informational) and 4 (Verbose).

fields.name: tls.key_file
fields.description: Absolute path to private Key file.

fields.name: tls.key_passwd
fields.description: Optional password for tls.key_file file.

fields.name: tls.max_version
fields.description: Specify the maximum version of TLS.

fields.name: tls.min_version
fields.description: Specify the minimum version of TLS.

fields.name: tls.verify
fields.description: Force certificate validation.

fields.name: tls.verify_hostname
fields.description: Enable or disable to verify hostname.

fields.name: tls.vhost
fields.description: Hostname to be used for TLS SNI extension.

fields.name: tls.windows.certstore_name
fields.description: Sets the certstore name on an output (Windows).

fields.name: tls.windows.use_enterprise_store
fields.description: Sets whether using enterprise certstore or not on an output (Windows).

fields.name: total_file_size
fields.description: Specify file size in S3. Minimum size is 1M. With use_put_object On the maximum size is 1G. With multipart uploads, the maximum size is 50G.

fields.name: upload_chunk_size
fields.description: The size of each part for multipart uploads. Default: 5M, Max: 50M, Min: 5M.

fields.name: upload_part_freshness_limit
fields.description: Maximum lifespan of an uncommitted file part.

fields.name: upload_parts_timeout
fields.description: Timeout to upload parts of a blob file.

fields.name: upload_timeout
fields.description: When this amount of time elapses, Fluent Bit uploads and creates a new file in S3. Set to 60m to upload a new file every hour.

fields.name: use_put_object
fields.description: Use the S3 PutObject API instead of the multipart upload API. When enabled, the key extension is only available when $UUID is specified in s3_key_format. If $UUID isn't included, a random string appends format string and the key extension can't be customized.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of workers to perform flush operations for this output.

description: Fluent Bit output plugin: Amazon S3.
